# Reporting a vulnerability

[Français](../SECURITY.md) · **English**

Email [Charles Lindecker](mailto:charles.lindecker@outlook.fr?subject=%5BSecurity%5D%20Bloodborne%20Legendary%20Run) privately with **[Security]** at the start of the subject line. Include the affected component and version, the impact you observed, and a safe way to contact you.

Keep the details confidential while the report is being assessed. Remove personal data and login information from anything you send.

For bugs with no security impact, visit [Support](SUPPORT.md).
